issues.legal_issue: An official deciding a tenure-holder’s holdings and ceiling area under the ceiling law is an authority for purposes of the consolidation law’s abatement provision.
material_facts: The Prescribed Authority acted under sections 10(2) and 12 of the ceiling law in deciding matters concerning the tenure-holder’s holdings.
issues.conclusion: The Prescribed Authority was an authority within the meaning of section 5(2) of the Consolidation Act.
issues.legal_principle: Section 5(2) of the U.P. Consolidation of Holdings Act, 1953 applies to proceedings pending before a court or authority. The Court held that a Prescribed Authority acting under sections 10(2) and 12 of the U.P. Imposition of Ceiling on Land Holdings Act, 1960 falls within that term. No earlier cases were relied on for this holding.

predicates.ceiling_determination_proceeding: The proceeding concerns determination of a tenure-holder’s holdings and the land that may be retained or treated as surplus.
predicates.decision_maker_adjudicates_holdings: The decision-maker determines matters concerning the tenure-holder’s holdings.

issues.definition: When a decision-maker determines holdings in a proceeding concerning a tenure-holder’s ceiling area, that decision-maker is a covered authority.

issues.legal_issue: A pending ceiling proceeding that involves a dispute over rights or interests in land within an area undergoing consolidation abates while consolidation operations are in progress.
material_facts: The tenure-holder had not filed its own statement of holdings, and the Prescribed Authority served it with a statement prepared by the authority.
The tenure-holder objected to that statement and disputed whether it held all the listed plots, as well as identifying plots it wished to retain.
Other persons had made claims to the tenure-holder’s plots in consolidation proceedings, and those claims were pending in revisions.
The land was within villages brought under consolidation operations.
The Prescribed Authority’s decision on whether the tenure-holder had an interest in the disputed plots would affect which plots were included in determining its ceiling area and surplus land.
issues.conclusion: The ceiling proceedings were proceedings in respect of declaration of rights or interests in land and therefore abated under section 5(2) of the Consolidation Act. They could be resumed after consolidation operations ended in the circumstances specified by the Court.
issues.legal_principle: Section 5(2) of the U.P. Consolidation of Holdings Act, 1953 provides for abatement of pending proceedings concerning declaration of rights or interests in land within the notified area. A voluntarily filed statement, or acceptance of a statement prepared by the authority, ordinarily presents no dispute about rights or interests; but a contested statement that raises a dispute over whether the tenure-holder has an interest in listed plots does. Sections 10 and 12 of the U.P. Imposition of Ceiling on Land Holdings Act, 1960 require the Prescribed Authority to determine that dispute, and section 32 makes the State a party. Section 49 of the Consolidation Act gives the consolidation process priority over overlapping proceedings; section 48A expressly preserves a different authority’s jurisdiction, but contains no similar exception for the Prescribed Authority. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: ceiling_determination_proceeding and consolidation_notification_covers_land and consolidation_operations_are_pending and ceiling_objection_contests_interest_in_listed_land and competing_claims_to_that_land_are_pending

predicates.ceiling_determination_proceeding: The proceeding determines a tenure-holder’s holdings, ceiling area, or surplus land.
predicates.consolidation_notification_covers_land: A notification has brought the land covered by the ceiling proceeding within a consolidation area.
predicates.consolidation_operations_are_pending: Consolidation operations concerning that land are still in progress.
predicates.ceiling_objection_contests_interest_in_l: The tenure-holder objects to the listed holdings by disputing whether it has an interest in some or all of the land.
predicates.competing_claims_to_that_land_are_pendin: Other persons’ claims to the same land remain pending in the consolidation process.

issues.definition: When a ceiling determination concerns land covered by pending consolidation operations and the tenure-holder and other claimants dispute interests in that land, the ceiling proceeding abates.
